sloka: नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम् ।कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ।। ५.६७.८ ।।।।
transliteration: nakhāgraiḥ kena te bhīru dāritaṁ tu stanāntaram ।kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā ।। 5.67.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are of timid nature. Who has scratched your breasts with the tip of the nail? Who is sporting with an enraged fivehooded serpent"?
